articles.1: the claim is the in-venue outcome, not external reproduction
articles.2: the evidence is bound to this package digest and interpreter
articles.5: no external party has an independent trust domain here

evidenceTheExternalPartyMustPublish: the exact package digest it received and the digest of every record it produced
the interpreter identity and operating system it used
the command line and the stripped or unstripped environment it ran under
its own signed verdict naming the outcome and any refusal code it observed
whatThisRecordDoesNotEstablish: that a claim in the A23 records is true
that the A23 differential is a machine-checked proof
that any party outside this project has run the package
whatWouldCountAsExternalReproduction: a party outside this project unpacks the package in its own environment, with no access to this checkout, and runs the declared command
that party reports the package digest, the interpreter version, the command it ran, the four record digests and the exit status
that party's verdict is signed by an identity in a trust domain distinct from this project's (Earned Trust Article 5), and the record names that domain and how it was established
